articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's X account hacked to promote token amid memecoin frenzy
articles.snippet: The post, now deleted, touted a token called $VLAD and falsely claimed it would be listed on Robinhood.

articles.title: Tassat wants to help smaller banks tap the trillion-dollar stablecoin boom before Wall Street lock them out
articles.snippet: The former Signet developer aims to launch early next year a marketplace connecting stablecoin issuers with regional lenders to manage reserves.

articles.title: Coinbase's corporate customers can now accept payments from AI agents
articles.snippet: Rolling out this week, Coinbase Business users will be able to accept payments from AI agents, done via the x402 protocol, developed and incubated by the exchange.

articles.title: The SEC settles with Coinbase over its missing Gary Gensler texts
articles.snippet: A new court status report reveals the agency will pay a flat fee to resolve a two-year fight over what former Chair Gary Gensler knew about Ethereum.
